scripts.speaker: Helper
scripts.text:
Newlyweds and
long time couples...
We invite you to Jawaii,
the honeymoon resort!
Jawaii?
Let's go to Jawaii~!
Cancel.

scripts.speaker: Helper
scripts.text:
There is an island far, far away from the Midgard continent.
It is a very quiet and beautiful island resort that only opens
its doors to couples.

scripts.speaker: Helper
scripts.text: This is an exclusive travel offer to the special honeymoon resort for Midgard's citizens. The price, 100,000 zeny, may be expensive, but you really get what you pay for.

scripts.speaker: Helper
scripts.text:
I guarantee you that some of
the happiest moments you can
experience in your marriage will be on this island. Can you really put a price on that?

scripts.speaker: Helper
scripts.text:
Errm...
Unfortunately, singles are not allowed on the island. Why don't you go forget your loneliness in the Prontera pub?

scripts.speaker: Helper
scripts.text:
Bon Voyage...!!
Let me guide
you to 'Jawaii!'

scripts.speaker: Helper
scripts.text: As I explained, you must have 100,000 zeny in order to visit Jawaii. Why don't you ask your partner for help in gathering the zeny for this trip?

scripts.speaker: Helper
scripts.text:
There's there no better way to share special, secluded moments with your beloved than through
a secret trip to a remote, exotic area.

scripts.speaker: Helper
scripts.text: A vacation in Jawaii could very well be the greatest gift that you could give to the one you love~
